Code quality rules for everything you write in this project:

- Keep the code clean and well-organized, with small reusable components.
- Add short, clear comments: one at the top of each file explaining its purpose, and comments on each important section or logic block.
- Use meaningful names for components, variables and functions.
- Keep colors, text and links in one place (design tokens or a data file) instead of hardcoding them everywhere, so changes are easy.

The Home page (/) must visually follow the head's HTML reference in reference/homepage (1).html: the retro arcade-console look, hero layout, effects and animations. Rebuild it as clean React components, do not copy the HTML blindly. Keep real content and structure from the Figma design.
